**About us:** 
 MONTICELLOAM, LLC and its affiliates (“Monticello”) is a real estate and asset\-based investment firm providing asset management and comprehensive capital solutions for healthcare, multifamily, and commercial real estate assets throughout the US. MonticelloAM is seeking team players who can work in a collaborative environment and possess drive, integrity, creativity, compassion, and a strong work ethic.
   

  

**About the role:** 
 We’re looking for a
 **Software Engineer** 
 to support Trustwell Living, Monticello’s affiliated senior living management company, by consolidating data from across all our systems into a single source of truth and building the tools our teams rely on every day. Trustwell Living is one of the fastest\-growing senior housing operators, currently managing 41 communities across the United States, and runs assisted living and memory care communities end to end, overseeing everything from clinical and resident care to staffing, budgets, and the operating systems that keep each community performing. You'll own the pipelines and warehouse that centralize their operational data, then build the reporting, dashboards, and internal applications that drive day\-to\-day operational decisions.
   

  

**This role is fully in person. Candidates must be able to work onsite at our office location.**
**Our Tech Stack**
**Role**
 At MonticelloAM, we build and operate our data platform using modern, scalable technologies. In this role, you’ll work hands\-on with:
   

  

**Application Development**
* Python for backend services, APIs, automation, and data engineering
* React for front\-end web interfaces and internal tools
* REST APIs that deliver data and tooling to business users


**Data Platform**
* Snowflake as our cloud data warehouse
* dbt for modular, version\-controlled data transformations
* Airflow for orchestration and workflow automation
* SQL for data modeling and analysis


**Infrastructure \& Delivery**
* AWS for cloud infrastructure and services
* Docker and CI/CD pipelines for automated, reliable deployment
* Git for version control and CI/CD


**Business Systems**
* Sage Intacct for accounting and financial management
* Ramp for spend management and corporate cards
* AVID for accounts payable automation
* ECP for electronic care planning and eMAR
* Welcome Home for CRM and resident move\-in management
* UKG for HR, payroll, and workforce management
* Teambridge for workforce scheduling and communication
* Monday.com for project and work management
* Jobvite for recruiting and applicant tracking


**About Your Team**
 You'll join an entrepreneurial, collaborative team that builds the data, reporting, and analytics systems powering Trustwell’s management operations and executive team. You'll work closely with the executive team, business stakeholders, and our offshore development teams to turn requirements into delivered solutions. Each team member owns their solutions, beyond just the technical implementation.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Serving as the primary engineering resource for Trustwell Living, taking projects end to end – from business problem to deployed, production solution
* Designing and building the data pipelines that bring data from all our systems into a single, reliable source of truth (Snowflake, Airflow, dbt)
* Building full\-stack internal applications – React front ends on Python APIs, including CRUD tools – that put data directly in front of business users
* Developing the reporting and dashboards that support day\-to\-day operations and portfolio decisions


**You'll Also Contribute To**
* Evolving our data models and warehouse architecture
* Data quality frameworks and automated QC processes
* Deployment, CI/CD, and monitoring that keep our systems running reliably
* Contributing to AI initiatives across processes and analytics, including helping shape new AI solutions


**Qualifications**
**Core:**
* Three to five years of work experience building and deploying software end to end – from concept through production
* Strong Python skills across data engineering, backend services, and APIs
* Hands\-on experience building data pipelines and transformations (Airflow, dbt, or similar)
* Experience with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred) and SQL
* Experience working directly with non\-technical stakeholders


**Also Valuable**
* DevOps experience – Docker, CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, and AWS
* Front\-end development with React
* Git and CI/CD practices
* Familiarity with HIPAA and safeguarding protected health information (PHI), given the resident data we handle


 We welcome applicants from a variety of educational and professional backgrounds. If you've built and shipped software and are looking to own projects end to end, we'd like to hear from you – even if your experience doesn't match every bullet.
   

  

**What We Value**
* A strong team player who thrives in a collaborative environment
* Excellent communication – a good listener asks insight\-generating questions
* Comfortable being uncomfortable – able to navigate ambiguity and rapid change
* An entrepreneurial mindset – be willing to take a risk on something new to improve the business, not just prescribed work
* Strong healthcare operations domain knowledge


 At Monticello, we believe that finding creative solutions for our clients comes from the collaboration of people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives. We strive to build an inclusive work environment that celebrates differences and empowers all individuals with opportunities to channel their entrepreneurial spirit. Monticello is an EEO employer.
   

  

 Monticello offers a competitive base salary and bonus. The base salary range for this position in New York City is $110,000 to $140,000/year. **What We Do**
 Insurance is a $10T industry still running on PDFs, email threads, and manual reconciliation. Ascend is changing that. We built the first and only complete financial operations platform purpose\-built for insurance — combining accounting automation, payments, and premium financing in a single vertically integrated solution. In five years, we've become the market leader: over 4,000 businesses, including more than half of the 50 largest brokers in the country, trust Ascend to bring clarity to complex accounting operations from collection to close.
   

  

**How We Do It**
 Ascend automates the financial operations that insurers, MGAs, and agencies run every day and embeds directly into the transactions where money actually moves. Point solutions are easy to build and even easier to copy. The companies that win won't just sell tools — they'll capture value where the money actually moves. Ascend is built for exactly that moment. Our customers don't just adopt software, they unlock measurable efficiency with a proven 5\-7x return on investment.
   

  

 Our team is onsite in San Francisco. We bring deep expertise in insurance, fintech, and financial infrastructure to build what the industry has never had.
   

  

**Why We Do It**
 The insurance industry intermediates trillions of dollars — and almost none of that infrastructure was built for the modern era. Legacy systems aren't just inefficient; they're a ceiling on what the industry can become.
   

  

 Ascend's mission is to become the leading financial automation platform for insurance by 2030 — powering the financial operations of the entire industry and transforming the way trillions of dollars move. We're not building another point solution, we're building the financial backbone of insurance.
   

  

 Your Role
   

  

 Ascend is seeking a Software Engineer to join our team on\-site in San Francisco to help expand our core product. As an Engineer at Ascend, you'll be part of a small but growing team focused on solving complex technical challenges using Ruby. You'll also interface directly with customers and work cross\-functionally to develop new product features, dashboards, and checkout processes—without any layers.
   

  

 Responsibilities Will Include
   

  

**Objective \#1: In your first 30 days:**
* Understand Ascend's platform, product, and customer workflows by collaborating with team members and engaging with customers
* Get up to speed on our prompt engineering and data extraction work, and how testing/monitoring is handled today
* Contribute to user\-facing projects
* Partner with product managers and designers to solve customer challenges directly


**Objective \#2: In your first 60 days:**
* Own prompt logic for a slice of the product — resolving data extraction issues and partnering with internal teams on testing and monitoring
* Track extraction accuracy and dig into trends when things go wrong
* Support new customer and organization onboarding through internal tooling improvements
* Take ownership of end\-to\-end features that process millions in insurance premiums
* Build intuitive UIs to power financial operations
* Maintain high product quality through proactive monitoring and continuous improvements


**Objective \#3: In your first 90 days and beyond:**
* Collaborate with customers to translate their needs into scalable solutions for the multi\-trillion\-dollar insurance industry
* Build reusable playbooks and prompt strategies that make future automation easier
* Develop the industry's leading point\-of\-sale system for insurance, enabling seamless payments and improving conversion rates
* Automate back\-office tasks with AI, reducing time and improving accuracy for accounting teams
* Help shape technical architecture and processes as the platform scales
* Mentor engineers through thoughtful code reviews and technical guidance


 Must Have
   

  

* 1\-3 years of relevant experience
* Experience working at a growth\-stage startup
* Experience with relational databases
* Experience building and scaling consumer products
* A strong desire to learn new skills and solve business problems


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Familiarity or interest in learning Ruby on Rails and Next.js
* Familiarity with building external APIs and integrations with platforms such as Salesforce
* Experience in building payment, checkout, or insurance products


 Tech Stack \& Processes
   

  

* Ruby on Rails API hosted on Heroku
